questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a sportsperson you admire. You should say: who this person is; what sport they play; what they have achieved; and explain why you admire this sportsperson.

questions.text: Have you ever watched this person compete?

questions.text: Why are top sportspeople paid so much money?
